name: default_two_page_output
input: User provides full EWA report text with no slide count specified.
expected: Exactly 2 slides/pages: Slide 1 is a 'Performance Indicators' table (Value | Metric) with the 9 fixed metrics; Slide 2 is an 'Early Watch Reports' table (# | Topic | Recommendation) with at most 6-8 findings, only using provided content.

name: performance_indicators_subset
input: User provides EWA report text whose Performance Indicators table contains more than the 9 required metrics (e.g., also Fiori Users, CPU Utilization, DB Request Times).
expected: Slide 1 table includes only the 9 fixed metrics in the specified order; extra metrics from the input are omitted.

name: missing_metric_value
input: User provides EWA report text missing one of the 9 required metrics (e.g., no 'DB Growth Last Month' row).
expected: Slide 1 table still shows a row for 'DB Growth Last Month' with value 'Not stated in input'; row is not dropped.

name: findings_from_alert_overview_and_dumps
input: User provides EWA report text with an Alert Overview bullet list and an ABAP Dumps (ST22) section listing dump types with counts.
expected: Slide 2 table includes rows for the Alert Overview items and a row listing the dump types/counts with recommendation 'Dumps analysis via ST22 is required' if stated; recommendation is 'Not stated in input' where not explicitly given.

name: explicit_slide_count_override
input: User provides EWA report text and explicitly asks for 8 slides.
expected: Exactly 8 slides with concise bullets (fallback outline), overriding the default fixed 2-page table format, only using provided content.

name: missing_info_handling
input: User provides partial EWA excerpt without SID/versions.
expected: Fields not present are shown as 'Not stated in input'.
